tldr: Mercury in the 2nd house: thinking becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Mercury in the 2nd house, this part of you works through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
